item.tib: man ngag gi rgyal po las rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i mjal snang
item.coloph: dkar chag bcad nas/ dung shog dkar po la/ mtshon chen snag tsha'i gter du dril nas/ gu ge brgyad pa 'di ni/ me mo yos bu lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga'i/ snga dro la tshar ba lags so/ skyes bu dam pa hor zhig lha rje'i mjal tshul 'di/ 'jang nas 'byung bzhin rin po che bzhin/ 'gro rnams mun rtag rul 'thib pa la/ mjal pa'i rig 'dzin sprin char 'thib pa 'dra/ de ltar ma brjed bzungs su zhog nyi zer ltar du rgyas 'gyur cig 'gro ba rnams la phan thog par shog bkra shis//
